issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: AgentSky
products.tagline: Any harness, any LLM — cloud-hosted agents on demand.
products.summaryZh: 任何工具，任何大语言模型——按需云托管代理。
products.descriptionZh: 托管代理即服务：一键启动长时程AI代理——支持Claude Code、Codex、Hermes或OpenClaw——具备完整历史记录、托管恢复功能，并可通过WhatsApp、iMessage、Telegram、Slack、网页、API开发者工具及命令行访问。
products.description: Managed agent as a service: launch a long-horizon AI agent in one click — Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw — with full history, managed recovery, and access through WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Slack, web, API developers, and CLI.

products.name: Ctruh Studio
products.tagline: Create interactive 3D and XR experiences without coding
products.summaryZh: 无需编码即可创建交互式3D与XR体验
products.descriptionZh: Ctruh Studio是一个由AI驱动的无代码平台，让任何人都能为网站创建、定制和发布交互式3D体验。利用AI生成3D资产，直接在浏览器中构建沉浸式产品展示、虚拟商店、配置器和AR体验。
products.description: Ctruh Studio is an AI-powered no-code platform that lets anyone create, customise and publish interactive 3D experiences for websites. Generate 3D assets with AI, build immersive product showcases, virtual stores, configurators and AR experiences directly in your browser.

products.name: Airtop for Google Ads Automation
products.tagline: Build campaigns, optimize spend, and create reports.
products.summaryZh: 构建营销活动，优化支出，并生成报告。
products.descriptionZh: Airtop通过对话构建、监控并优化你的Google Ads广告系列。关键词研究、广告系列创建、浪费审计和效果报告——无需专业知识。
products.description: Airtop builds, monitors, and optimizes your Google Ads campaigns from a conversation. Keyword research, campaign creation, waste audits, and performance reporting — no expertise required.

products.name: Qwen3.8-Max
products.tagline: Qwen’s most capable model for coding and cowork
products.summaryZh: Qwen在编程与协作方面能力最强的模型
products.descriptionZh: Qwen3.8-Max是Qwen迄今最强大的模型，拥有2.4万亿参数的MoE架构，其中95B参数处于激活状态，支持100万上下文，并具备多模态智能体能力，适用于编程、研究、协作及长周期任务。
products.description: Qwen3.8-Max is Qwen’s most capable model to date, a 2.4T-parameter MoE with 95B active parameters, 1M context, and multimodal agent capabilities for coding, research, cowork, and long-horizon tasks.

products.name: Appllama
products.tagline: Study 25,000+ screens from top-earning iOS apps
products.summaryZh: 研究收入最高的iOS应用中超过25,000个屏幕
products.descriptionZh: Appllama是一个面向应用创作者的设计研究平台。搜索来自App Store中600多款收入最高的iOS应用的25,000多个屏幕；跟踪完整的引导流程、付费墙、首页和应用内流程；检查UI元素、颜色和字体；并查看收入、下载量和评分等背景信息。每周新增应用，直接从商店实时抓取。免费开始，无需信用卡。
products.description: Appllama is a design-research platform for app creators. Search 25,000+ screens from 600+ of the App Store’s top-earning iOS apps; follow complete onboarding, paywall, home and in-app flows; inspect UI elements, colors and fonts; and see revenue, downloads and ratings in context. New apps arrive weekly, captured live from the store. Start free no card required.

products.name: Plethora
products.tagline: Youtube for interactive content
products.summaryZh: YouTube，用于互动内容。
products.descriptionZh: Plethora是一个互动内容平台：一个承载微体验的信息流。迷你游戏、谜题、数字解压玩具、互动艺术、微型世界、教育模拟。每一个元素都可以被触摸、移动、戳弄和玩耍。内容会对你做出回应。
products.description: Plethora is a platform for interactive content: a feed where micro-experiences live. Mini-games, puzzles, digital fidgets, interactive art, tiny worlds, educational simulations. Every bit can be touched, moved, poked, and played with. The content responds to you.

products.name: claudemon
products.tagline: Wild Pokémon appear while you wait for Claude Code
products.summaryZh: 等待Claude Code时，野生宝可梦会出现。
products.descriptionZh: Claude Code的一半时间都在等待。claudemon把这段时间变成游戏：你的提示词是穿过草丛的脚步，每工作20秒就多走一步。有东西跳出来时，状态栏会提示，你在第二个终端标签页里与它战斗。全部151个，完全本地运行，无需账户。
products.description: Half of Claude Code is waiting. claudemon makes that time a game: your prompts are steps through the grass, every 20s of work another step. Something jumps out, the status line says so, you fight it in a second terminal tab. All 151, fully local, no account.

products.name: Snapdown
products.tagline: Turn anything on your Mac screen into clean Markdown
products.summaryZh: 将Mac屏幕上的任何内容转换为整洁的Markdown。
products.descriptionZh: Snapdown可将Mac屏幕的任意部分转换为结构化的Markdown，保留标题、列表、表格和文本，而非将所有内容扁平化为纯OCR文本。通过一个快捷键即可捕捉，随处粘贴，并在Apple silicon上保持所有截图本地存储。
products.description: Snapdown turns any part of your Mac screen into structured Markdown, preserving headings, lists, tables, and text instead of flattening everything into plain OCR. Capture with one shortcut, paste anywhere, and keep every screenshot local on Apple silicon.

products.name: Hand Wave
products.tagline: Turn sign language into speech with smart glasses
products.summaryZh: 用智能眼镜将手语转化为语音
products.descriptionZh: Hand Wave利用Meta智能眼镜的摄像头，将手语转化为文字和语音。它还支持跨平台使用（iOS + 网页）。其底层是一个轻量级、开源的神经网络，基于Google的FSBoard数据集训练，并设计为可在各设备上本地运行（开发中）。
products.description: Hand Wave turns sign language into text and speech using the camera on Meta smart glasses. It also works cross-platform (iOS + web). Under the hood is a lightweight, open-source neural network trained on Google’s FSBoard dataset and built to run locally across devices (wip).

products.name: mpai
products.tagline: Make existing Codex and Claude Code sessions multiplayer
products.summaryZh: 让现有的 Codex 和 Claude Code 会话支持多人协作。
products.descriptionZh: 开源终端多人协作工具，适用于Codex和Claude Code。从另一台Mac加入队友明确共享的原生会话，带着真实上下文抵达，并以你的名字附注进行提示。Tailscale保持私密；主机Mac保持控制权。
products.description: Open-source terminal multiplayer for Codex and Claude Code. Join a teammate's explicitly shared native session from another Mac, arrive with the real context, and prompt with your name attached. Tailscale stays private; the host Mac stays in control.

products.name: PassiveShorts
products.tagline: AI Faceless Video Generator for TikTok & YouTube
products.summaryZh: AI无脸视频生成器，适用于TikTok与YouTube
products.descriptionZh: AI无脸视频生成器，自动发布到YouTube和TikTok。选择主题、声音和日程。我们为你撰写、配音、添加字幕并发布每一个短视频。
products.description: AI faceless video generator that auto-posts to YouTube and TikTok. Pick a topic, a voice, and a schedule. We write, voice, caption, and post every Short for you.

products.name: MascotAI
products.tagline: Animated SVG mascot studios for apps that need a personality
products.summaryZh: 为需要个性化形象的应用程序设计的动画SVG吉祥物工作室
products.descriptionZh: 嘿，猎人们！我是MascotAI的开发者。我总看到应用带着好产品上线，却配着让人记不住的面孔。插画预算庞大；通用AI头像在产品界面里显得毫无生气。所以我们按照自己发货的方式打造了工作室：带手势、主题和可实际切换部件的动画SVG包，而不是一次性的PNG图片。
products.description: Hey hunters! I’m the maker of MascotAI. I kept seeing apps launch with great products and forgettable faces. Illustration budgets are huge; generic AI avatars feel lifeless in product UI. So we built studios the way we’d ship them ourselves: animated SVG packs with gestures, themes, and parts you can actually toggle not one-off PNG images.

products.name: Inventory
products.tagline: Search every AI Agent & IDE Conversation
products.summaryZh: 搜索每一个AI代理与IDE对话
products.descriptionZh: Inventory是每个Cursor、Claude Code、Zed、Codex和Kiro对话的私有本地索引。无需注册，无需云端，一次性付费。
products.description: Inventory is the private, local index for every Cursor, Claude Code, Zed, Codex and Kiro conversation. No signups, no cloud, one-time fee.

products.name: MacDupl
products.tagline: Clone any Mac app into a fully isolated instance
products.summaryZh: 将任何Mac应用克隆为完全独立的实例
products.descriptionZh: MacDupl 将您已使用的 Mac 应用克隆为完全隔离的实例——独立的登录、独立的数据、独立的 Dock 图标。工作与个人，并排共存。
products.description: MacDupl clones the Mac apps you already use into fully isolated instances — separate logins, separate data, separate Dock icons. Work and personal, side by side.

products.name: CoachAI
products.tagline: Your iPhone camera watches your form, rep by rep
products.summaryZh: 你的iPhone摄像头会逐次观察你的动作姿势。
products.descriptionZh: CoachAI利用手机摄像头实时计数您的动作次数并纠正姿势——如同将私人教练的双眼装进口袋。
products.description: CoachAI uses your phone's camera to count your reps and correct your form in real time - a personal trainer's eyes in your pocket.

products.name: Murmell
products.tagline: Cloud canvas where your team and AI agents works together
products.summaryZh: 团队与AI代理协作的云端画布
products.descriptionZh: Murmell 是一个共享云端画布，让你的团队和 AI 代理在同一房间、同一仓库中协作，并带有预览功能，未来还将推出更多功能。合上笔记本电脑，工作仍会继续。代理在写入前会认领文件，因此人和代理可以同时推进，而不会互相覆盖。今天即可同时运行 Claude Code、Codex、Kimi 和 OpenCode，更多代理（如 OpenClaw、Hermes 等）即将加入，你的工作成果会落回 git，因此你总能在此找到你的项目。
products.description: Murmell is a shared cloud canvas where your team and AI agents work in the same room, on the same repo, with a preview and more coming in the future. Close your laptop and the work keeps going. Agents claim files before they write, so people and agents can move at once without overwriting each other. Run Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, and OpenCode together today, with more agents on the way (OpenClaw, Hermes, and more), and your work lands back in git, so you can always find your projects there.

products.name: The Garden of Mind
products.tagline: Your subconscious mind as a living 3D garden you water daily
products.summaryZh: 你的潜意识如同一座每日浇灌的立体花园。
products.descriptionZh: 心灵花园是你潜意识的具象化。你关注什么，便会在心中种下什么——所以，有意识地种下一件事。写下你的意图，它便成为一座生动3D花园中的一颗种子。每天浇灌两分钟：读它，与之呼吸，想象它已然成真。植物随真实日历日生长，你所见的，正是你持续选择的结果。免费开始，无需账户，无需安装。Founders Pro一次性29欧元——永不续费。
products.description: The Garden of Mind is a visualisation of your subconscious mind. Whatever you hold in your attention gets planted in you — so plant one thing on purpose. Write an intention and it becomes a seed in a living 3D garden. Water it two minutes a day: read it, breathe with it, picture it as already true. The plant grows across real calendar days, so what you see is what you kept choosing. Free to start, no account, nothing to install. Founders Pro is €29 once — nothing renews, ever.

products.name: Doxy
products.tagline: Markdown & HTML editor, without the LaTeX pain
products.summaryZh: Markdown 与 HTML 编辑器，告别 LaTeX 的烦恼
products.descriptionZh: Doxy是一款基于浏览器的编辑器，用于创建简洁、专业的文档，支持Markdown和HTML，无需LaTeX的复杂性，也不必忍受编译等待的烦恼。在一个简单、快速的编辑器中写作、排版并预览你的作品。
products.description: Doxy is a browser-based editor for creating clean, professional documents with Markdown and HTML without the complexity of LaTeX or the frustration of compile times. Write, format, and preview your work in one simple, fast editor.

products.name: yapyap
products.tagline: Own your voice again. Local-first voice & meeting recorder.
products.summaryZh: 重新掌握你的声音。本地优先的语音与会议记录工具。
products.descriptionZh: 每款会议记录器都会将你的音频上传至云端，并按月收费。yapyap则两者皆不。它在你自己的设备上完成录音、转写、识别发言人，并将对话转化为摘要和行动项。“Lenses”可将每段录音重塑为你所需的任何形式：摘要、待办清单或决策日志。你可以安装更多，或自行构建。偏好云端？可选连接任何主流提供商：OpenAI、Anthropic、Groq。无论哪种方式，yapyap永远属于你。无需订阅。
products.description: Every meeting recorder ships your audio to the cloud and bills you monthly. yapyap does neither. It records, transcribes, names your speakers, and turns talk into summaries and action items entirely on your own machine. “Lenses” reshape each recording into whatever you need: a summary, a to-do list, or a decision log. You can install more or build your own. Prefer the cloud? Optionally connect any major provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq. Either way, yapyap is yours forever. No subscription.

products.name: gesture.live
products.tagline: Play live electronic music with your hands using your webcam
products.summaryZh: 用你的网络摄像头，用手演奏现场电子音乐。
products.descriptionZh: 通过网络摄像头，用双手演奏现场电子音乐。和弦、贝斯、鼓点和效果，皆通过手势演绎。
products.description: Play live electronic music with your hands over a webcam. Chords, bass, drums and effects, performed through gestures.
